# FDG8105

> DO overload the equality operators on value types, if equality is meaningful.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.13.1 Equality Operators on Value Types.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA2231
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

CA2231 reports an externally visible struct that overrides Equals without overloading operator == (probe with SDK 10.0.402); overriding Equals is how the code says that equality is meaningful. A struct that does not override Equals is not reported by CA2231, so coverage is partial; CA1815 (FDG8067) reports it. The SDK code fix adds operator == and != that call Equals (probe), which changes no signature.

## From the book

In most programming languages, there is no default implementation of `operator==` for value types.
